name: What factors influence the cost of water-damaged drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of water-damaged drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence the cost, including the total square footage of drywall needing replacement, the type of drywall used (e.g., standard, mold-resistant, fire-rated), and the extent of water damage to underlying structures like insulation or framing. Accessibility to the damaged area, necessary mold remediation, and painting to match existing finishes also contribute to the overall expense. Costs can also vary based on local labor rates in areas like the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include damaged area size, drywall type, underlying structural damage, mold remediation, and local labor rates.
